name: simulate-qcd-execution-input-boundary
why: Measured reach for immutable named-QCD evidence and executor-input preparation extracted from simulatePlan. Existing named-QCD corpus members exercise alive/prior-offset evidence, prerequisite evaluation, exact-cent floored source capacity, owner RMD-pool snapshots, staged per-account gift attribution, complete owned-IRA Form 8606 pool input, the caller contract, and the retained executor handoff in all four equivalence modes. Direct contract tests own the no-request and blocked-prerequisite exits, unprovable prior-offset omission, cent-floor arithmetic, complete-pool arithmetic, deterministic account ordering, and frozen envelopes. Hostile delegation separately proves the caller consumes withheld execution, zeroed source capacity, and absent complete-pool capacity instead of rebuilding any coordinator output inline.

readingTheCounts: A member count proves at least one line in the named range executed. Reach additionally fails on a cold executable whole line inside a reached range. Direct tests own no-request and blocked exits, unprovable prior-offset omission, cent-floor and pool arithmetic, ordering, and frozen envelopes; hostile delegation owns consumption of the prepared call, source capacity, and complete-pool channel. JavaScript line coverage cannot distinguish every ternary or compound operand sharing a physical line, so reported cold sub-line regions must be read alongside those focused tests.
